current_point.claim: 基于四个真实世界中的大规模图数据集，我们首先使用提出的DSGNN框架实现了三个经典图神经网络模型的分布式版本，并比较集中式与分布式训练下模型性能的差异。
current_point.claim_en: Based on four real-world large-scale graph datasets, we first implemented distributed versions of three classic GNN models using the proposed DSGNN framework and compared the performance differences between centralized and distributed training.
